changes.result: Added a crate-only invocation binder that derives selected tool and executable identity from the exact plan and LiveContext, then binds caller-supplied argv and bounded execution policy without reconstructing authority from digests.

Preparation structurally matches the read-only context binding, graph, complete snapshot, plan, selected set, and exact invocation order. It performs only serialization and digest work and emits no process or workspace effect.

Nonempty plans produce deterministic intent commitments under a unique atomic issuance and private seal. RoutineEffectRequest has private fields and constructor, is not serializable or deserializable, and is consumed exactly once into sealed mediation authority plus ordered non-Clone intent tokens.

Expectation binding copies the opaque issuance seal into a non-Clone mediated expectation. Only consuming that expectation can bind an executed or reused witness, and only the exact matching intent token can observe it. Structurally identical requests, copied IDs, replayed transitions, and prior-request executed or reused witnesses fail closed.

Each intent records protocol and intent IDs, plan order, node, selected tool and full capability identity, program path hex, program content digest, byte length and mode, argv, canonical worktree cwd, fixed clear environment policy, timeout, output budget, output scopes, dependency node expectations, input identity, and mandatory root mediation preflight.

Adapter validation rejects cardinality, duplicate, unknown, issuance, session, order, observation, witness, skip, and failure defects before report delegation. Validation is phased so a decisive structural defect is not masked by a later incomplete disposition.

Only an exact complete observed set becomes ReportRecords. Existing reconcile_report then revalidates live authority and exact executed or reused dependency artifact chains; the adapter cannot mint reuse evidence or complete status itself.

Ten direct controls cover clean no-op, dirty and strict ordered preparation, runner and policy substitution, stale context graph snapshot and plan, partial reordered and copied-ID outcomes, repeated transitions, prior-request intents and executed or reused witnesses, genuine completion, dependency artifact substitution, concurrent mutation, and source-level effect primitive absence.

findings.finding: The accepted plan has tool-selection authority but intentionally lacks argv, cwd, environment, timeout, budget, and output-scope semantics. The adapter now requires a separate exact invocation spec instead of fabricating those values from plan prose or digests.

The first validation loop examined disposition completeness before reaching a later duplicate row. Validation now completes cardinality, duplicate, session, unknown, order, and observation checks for the entire set before inspecting dispositions.

Independent review proved that a borrowed request plus structurally equal intent could restamp a prior request's witness with new string IDs. The borrowed constructor was removed. Request mediation now consumes by value and carries one opaque Arc-backed issuance through ordered intent, expectation, witness, outcome, and final authority transitions; copied IDs and prior-request executed or reused witnesses fail closed.

No effect grant or mediator exists in this candidate. The request can only describe intended work; a separately reviewed root mediator must take ownership by value and revalidate every bound authority immediately before effects.
No public catalog, parser, dispatcher, help, successor_public, command_run, or binary route imports this crate-only protocol.

One of the two root-reconciliation dependency-closed runs reported two unrelated nextest LEAK diagnostics under parallel load. The other root-reconciliation dependency run and both worker focused runs were clean, all 249 controls passed twice under root reconciliation, and no test failed.

limitations: The standard six-artifact aggregate excludes this WorkerResult by design; the WorkerResult is separately digestible after creation.

Preparation validates the exact supplied immutable context and plan objects but intentionally performs no live Git or process revalidation. Every intent binds a mandatory future-mediator preflight, and no effect is authorized before that root-owned check exists.

Static intents can bind exact dependency node expectations but not upstream result artifact digests that do not exist before execution. Exact result digests are enforced after observation by accepted report reconciliation.

The internal API enforces move-only request, intent, expectation, witness, outcome, and reconciliation transitions. A future mediator must preserve those types by value; this worker does not implement or authorize effects.
Output scopes are validated repository-relative, bounded, sorted, and case-unique, but actual filesystem confinement and immediate identity revalidation belong to the pending mediator.
The crate-only adapter is direct-path tested and intentionally has no production caller until root mediation and public activation are accepted.

The WorkerResult schema requires its shorter literal no-claim value; the stronger lease ceiling remains binding verbatim: This worker implements an internal routine adapter protocol only.
